items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: you mentioned you taught him one little song... I said go ahead and get it. And he went and he got that little ten cents flute and that's where he started.

ctx.x: Okay, we got it on again. This is Zeno. We're back interviewing you.
So used to him. I'm so used to him. It's just like George to me.
The last time you were talking, you asked if you should speak in French. Would you rather talk in French than English usually?

items.title: Alice Zeno Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: No no. To have an easier name you know. No no. It was just by having so much trouble with the insurance. Insurance. He just let it go George Lewis short.

ctx.x: And just let it be George Lewis. They called him that down on the river front too. Yes. That name. I thought maybe he changed it on account of music.
No no. To have an easier name you know. No no. It was just by having so much trouble with the insurance. Insurance. He just let it go George Lewis short. But all his children and his wife and
and how did you pronounce his first name originally was it Francois or how do you?
